components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default high-contrast action for opening rooms and adding evidence.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height:44px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:0; padding:.68rem 1.05rem; font:760 .76rem 'Manrope Variable','Helvetica Neue',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.035em; transition:color 160ms ease,background-color 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease,transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); cursor:pointer; } .ds-button-primary { background:var(--ink,#22221f); color:var(--surface,#faf8f2); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:#3a3934; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ember,#c6492d); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined low-emphasis action for joining and saving edits.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height:44px; border-radius:0; padding:.68rem 1.05rem; font:760 .76rem 'Manrope Variable','Helvetica Neue',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.035em; transition:color 160ms ease,background-color 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease,transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); cursor:pointer; } .ds-button-secondary { border:1px solid var(--rule-dark,#99958a); background:transparent; color:var(--ink,#22221f); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color:var(--ink,#22221f); background:var(--paper-deep,#e9e6dc); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ember,#c6492d); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Ember action reserved for consequential incident operations.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height:44px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:0; padding:.68rem 1.05rem; font:760 .76rem 'Manrope Variable','Helvetica Neue',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.035em; transition:background-color 160ms ease,transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); cursor:pointer; } .ds-button-danger { background:var(--ember,#c6492d); color:#fff8f3; } .ds-button-danger:hover { background:var(--ember-dark,#96341f); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ember,#c6492d); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square lifted-paper input with a compact uppercase label.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.55rem; color:var(--muted,#6d6a61); font-family:'Manrope Variable','Helvetica Neue',sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size:.72rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.06em; } .ds-field-input { min-height:52px; border:1px solid var(--rule,#cbc7bb); border-radius:0; padding:.8rem .95rem; background:var(--surface,#faf8f2); color:var(--ink,#22221f); font:400 .92rem 'Manrope Variable','Helvetica Neue',sans-serif; transition:border-color 160ms ease,background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color:var(--ink,#22221f); outline:none; background:#fffdf7; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ember,#c6492d); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Room Code Badge
components.description: Operational identifier pairing a small label with a tracked mono code.
components.css: .ds-room-code { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.65rem; border:1px solid var(--rule-dark,#99958a); border-radius:0; padding:.68rem .8rem; color:var(--ink,#22221f); font:500 .73rem 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.11em; } .ds-room-label { color:var(--muted,#6d6a61); font:700 .62rem 'Manrope Variable',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.07em; }

components.name: Block Card
components.description: Rule-separated evidence entry with compact subject and mono provenance.
components.html:
OBSERVATION

Checkout failures began after the cache rollout.

components.css: .ds-block-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.8rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#cbc7bb); border-radius:0; padding:1rem; background:transparent; color:var(--ink,#22221f); font-family:'Manrope Variable','Helvetica Neue',sans-serif; transition:background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-block-card:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.42); } .ds-block-subject { color:var(--muted,#6d6a61); font-size:.65rem; font-weight:750; letter-spacing:.07em; } .ds-block-body { margin:0; font-size:.82rem; line-height:1.55; } .ds-block-meta { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; color:var(--muted,#6d6a61); font:500 .59rem 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; }

components.name: Error Toast
components.description: Square ember-wash alert with an underlined dismissal action.
components.html: Could not resolve the incident.
components.css: .ds-toast { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem; border:1px solid #d7a99c; border-radius:0; padding:.8rem .9rem; background:var(--ember-wash,#f4ded6); color:#792b1a; font:400 .78rem/1.45 'Manrope Variable','Helvetica Neue',sans-serif; } .ds-toast-action { border:0; padding:0; background:transparent; color:inherit; font:700 .68rem 'Manrope Variable',sans-serif; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.24em; cursor:pointer; } .ds-toast-action:hover { text-decoration-thickness:2px; } .ds-toast-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ember,#c6492d); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Live Room State
components.description: Tracked mono live-state label with the restrained ember pulse.
components.css: .ds-room-state { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.6rem; color:var(--ember-dark,#96341f); font:650 .65rem 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.09em; } .ds-signal { width:.48rem; height:.48rem; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ember,#c6492d); animation:ds-signal 2s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-signal { 0%,100% { box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(198,73,45,.28); } 55% { box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(198,73,45,0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-signal { animation-duration:.01ms; animation-iteration-count:1; } }

narrative.overview:
CodeTalk feels like a warm paper operations ledger made live: calm charcoal type, crisp rules, and dense evidence arranged for scanning under pressure. The editorial scale creates urgency through hierarchy rather than visual noise, while the workspace stays utilitarian and legible.

The system is flat, square, and deliberately restrained. Ember appears only where attention is operationally urgent; moss closes the loop when an incident is resolved. Motion is brief and state-bearing, with a reduced-motion path built into the global layer.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and charcoal foundations separated by hairline rules.
Oversized, tightly tracked Manrope headlines paired with compact operational labels.
IBM Plex Mono reserved for codes, counts, states, and timestamps.
Square controls and border-defined regions rather than floating cards.
A persistent five-column evidence workspace that becomes a horizontal snap track on small screens.

rules.name: The Two-State Accent Rule
rules.body: Ember means active urgency; moss means resolved state. Never use either as general decoration.

rules.name: The Ruled Paper Rule
rules.body: Separate information with neutral paper shifts and one-pixel rules before introducing a new color.

rules.name: The Operational Mono Rule
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Mono only for codes, timestamps, counters, indices, and terse machine-like states; prose and ordinary labels remain Manrope.

rules.name: The Scale, Then Restrain Rule
rules.body: Create emphasis with Manrope size and tight tracking; do not add a decorative display face.

rules.name: The Five Lanes Rule
rules.body: Logs, hypotheses, fix attempts, root cause, and custom evidence remain distinct columns at every viewport; responsiveness changes navigation, not information architecture.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flush and ruled; do not use ambient drop shadows to manufacture hierarchy.

rules.name: The Circles Are Alive Rule
rules.body: Circular geometry belongs to people, presence, and status signals; content containers and controls remain square.

dos: Do preserve the paper-and-rule structure before adding any new surface treatment.
Do use ember for active urgency and moss for resolved state.
Do keep the five evidence types visually and spatially distinct on every viewport.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences and keep feedback transitions between 140ms and 180ms.
Do reserve IBM Plex Mono for operational data that benefits from fixed-width scanning.
donts: Don't use ember or moss as decorative brand color across large areas.
Don't round cards, buttons, fields, alerts, or badges; circles belong to live actors and signals.
Don't add ambient drop shadows, gradients, glass effects, or floating card stacks.
Don't collapse the incident workspace into one undifferentiated vertical feed on mobile.
Don't introduce glyph-only controls or a decorative display typeface; neither belongs to the shipped visual language.
